history.title: Cosine LR schedule with warmup
history.prediction_check: Predicted a 2% improvement but got a 7% regression, likely because cosine decay reduced time at high LR and hurt final convergence in the short budget.

history.title: Increase model width to 384
history.prediction_check: Prediction was wrong: widening to 384 hurt val_loss (+1.5%) despite more params, likely due to fewer steps (1525 vs 2719) and overfitting.

history.title: Correct cosine LR decay to zero
history.prediction_check: Predicted -2% improvement but got +0.09% regression; the math import issue likely made the run fall back to a constant LR, so the cosine schedule was never actually exercised.

history.title: Add EMA of model weights
history.prediction_check: The EMA idea crashed due to lazy array accumulation and a parameter name mismatch, so the predicted -1.5% improvement was not tested.

history.title: Remove text encoder, use learned embedding
history.prediction_check: Outcome was directionally correct but weaker than predicted: -0.52% vs -2.0%, likely because throughput gain (3053 vs 2719 steps) was smaller than hoped.

history.title: Constant LR with linear cooldown
history.prediction_check: Predicted -1.5% improvement but got +0.69% regression; removing warmup hurt, likely due to early instability or lost warmup benefit.

history.title: Reduce beta2 to 0.95
history.prediction_check: Outcome was far weaker than predicted (-0.06% vs -0.8%), suggesting beta2 reduction has minimal effect within this short run.

history.title: Remove warmup, keep linear warmdown
history.prediction_check: Predicted -0.5% improvement but got +0.45% regression; warmup removal still hurts even with beta2=0.95, so the faster-adapting optimizer does not compensate.

history.title: Increase learning rate to 1e-3
history.prediction_check: Prediction matched almost exactly: LR 1e-3 improved val_loss by -1.496% vs predicted -1.5%, with no instability and more steps (2890 vs 2719).

history.title: Increase batch size to 256
history.prediction_check: Prediction was wrong: doubling batch to 256 regressed val_loss by +2.0% instead of improving by -1.0%, likely because step count dropped 46% (2719 to 1465) and memory pressure slowed throughput.

history.title: Remove warmup, keep cosine warmdown
history.prediction_check: Prediction was wrong: removing warmup at LR 1e-3 with beta2=0.95 regressed val_loss by +0.2% instead of improving -0.5%, despite gaining ~127 steps.

history.title: Add weight decay 0.01
history.prediction_check: Predicted -0.8% improvement but got +0.14% regression; weight decay 0.01 slightly hurt val_loss, likely due to over-regularization within short budget.
